title: Honesty in Testimony
subtitle: A concise collection of practical notes and insights on the Islamic perspective on false witness and truthfulness.

notes.title: What is Shahadat al-Zūr?
notes.paragraph: Shahadat al-Zūr describes testimony that has been deliberately bent and twisted away from reality[cite: 3].

notes.title: A Grave Major Sin
notes.paragraph: The Prophet (ﷺ) explicitly counted false witness among the gravest of major sins, repeating his warning until the Companions wished he would stop[cite: 3].

notes.title: The Real Harm Caused
notes.paragraph: Dishonest testimony can misappropriate property, damage reputations, mislead decision-makers, and erode public trust[cite: 5].

notes.title: The Standard of Truth
notes.paragraph: A truthful witness has two duties: adding nothing false and concealing nothing relevant, standing firmly for justice regardless of personal bias[cite: 4, 6].

notes.title: Verify Before You Speak
notes.paragraph: True accountability means knowing before you speak, separating facts from opinions, and carefully verifying news before passing it on[cite: 6, 7].
